kim: FYI rolling out audit event suppression for noisy KMS rotations. Want to share the customer-facing validation plan and example payloads. PTAL please.

aj: Thanks — can you outline the suppression criteria? Is it based on event.type or fields?

kim: Criteria: (1) repeated identical key-rotation events within 5m from same principal => suppress duplicates, (2) health-check pings from kms-proxy => drop, (3) customer opt-in flag `audit.allow_noisy_kms: false` => full detail. Draft:
```json
{"event_type":"kms.key.rotate","principal":"service:deploy-agent","key_id":"abc123","severity":"info","meta":{"rotations":1}}
```

maria: We need to ensure SIEM mapping still gets a 'rotation' marker even for suppressed events. Could we emit a single aggregated event instead? :thinking: 

kim: Yes aggregate event will be emitted with `suppressed_count` and `window_seconds`. Example:
```json
{"event_type":"kms.key.rotate.aggregated","key_id":"abc123","suppressed_count":42,"window_seconds":300}
```

samir: Any customer docs updates required? I'll draft a changelog blurb and sample API contract.

kim: Please add a short customer-facing validation checklist: how to opt into full payloads, sample queries to validate, example SIEM mapping. Link to internal RFC: https://redwood.local/rfcs/kms-audit-suppression

aj: Quick question on RBAC: will this change the privileged action classification? For audit retention rules we must preserve 'who' and 'when' even when payload suppressed.

kim: No change to classification. Suppression only affects repeated metadata fields; we keep `principal` and `timestamp` in aggregated records. We'll log full raw payloads to encrypted cold storage (KMS-wrapped) for 90 days. Access via audit-request flow.

maria: Can you add an example of the integrity proof header? SOC customers ask for a tamper-evidence header.

kim: Added header example in the RFC. Example header: `X-Audit-Blob-Sig: sha256=<sig>` and we include `kms_key_id`.

auditbot: automated test run: audit-schema v3 validation OK for aggregated event schema (warnings: 'suppressed_count' optional). :white_check_mark:

samir: I'll post the customer preview tomorrow, want to include a short FAQ: Why suppress, how to opt-out, SIEM tips.

kim: Thanks all. Action items: samir draft changelog + cust preview; maria update SIEM mapping doc; aj verify RBAC retention flow; I'll open PR for runtime filters. Plan to announce to customers in 48h if no blockers.

aj: :thumbsup:

samir: On it, will share link when ready.

kim: thread locked to edit, but keep comments here.
